messages:
raluca: Heads-up — VectraCare dedicated rollout is targeted for Thu 03/12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need ops + SRE consent. Planning to pin model -> v2.4.1-quant and prewarm KV cache. KMS rotation originally planned same morning, please confirm no collision.

matt: SG; what's the canary cadence and rollback criteria?

raluca: Canary plan: 5% for 30m, then 30% for 30m, then 100% cutover. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 400ms OR error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Also abort if any model output regression from eval set fails.

maya: Need the exact deploybot flags + prewarm steps. Also can security confirm KMS timing?

raluca: Deploy command (dry-run first):
```
/deploy vectracare --env=dedi-prod --model=v2.4.1-quant --canary=5,30 --staged=30 --drain-time=300 --pin=true --prewarm-prefixes=customer:priming-list.txt
```
Prewarm: run prewarm job 60m before canary opens to warm KV cache (~50k prefixes).

deploybot: DRY-RUN OUTPUT for deploy vectracare v2.4.1-quant
- manifest diff: 3 small tweaks (resources, liveness)
- estimated priming tokens: 1.15M
- recommended prewarm concurrency: 8 workers
- compatibility checks: OK
- kms preview: no key usage conflicts detected in staging
---
Summary: dry-run PASS.

ops_lead: Prewarm step approved from ops side. We'll queue the prewarm job at T-60. Ops will reserve +15% capacity headroom for the window.

matt: Noted. Add to release notes: "Pin model v2.4.1-quant for deterministic latency; KV cache prewarmed; Canary: 5% -> 30% -> full; Rollback thresholds: p95>400ms OR error-rate>0.5%."

maya: Security update: KMS rotation bumped to 07:00 UTC to avoid collision with the 02:00 window. Security confirmed.

sre_oncall: SRE ack. We'll monitor p50/p95, qps, error-rate. If p50 increases >2x during canary we hold and investigate. Also set automatic traffic rollback policy tied to error-rate.

raluca: Small schedule tweak per SRE: canary 5% for 30m, then 30% for 30m, then hold for 15m before full cutover for emergency checks.

matt: +1

ops_lead: +1 from ops (capacity reserved, prewarm job scheduled).

deploybot: Scheduling prewarm job:
```
/prewarm job start vectracare --prefix-file=customer:priming-list.txt --concurrency=8 --eta=60m
Status: queued (job id: prewarm-5523)
```

raluca: Final approvals checklist: ProductOps (matt) ✅, Security (maya) ✅, SRE (sre_oncall) ✅, Ops (ops_lead) ✅. Tagging oncall: @sre_oncall for real-time monitoring.

matt: I'll publish the short release note to the customer channel immediately after prewarm starts.

maya: Confirming security will run a post-cutover audit for KMS access logs.

sre_oncall: I'll be online for the window and will post metrics snapshots every 10m to this thread.

raluca: Thanks all — proceeding with the dry-run at T-6h and full rollout per the schedule unless any objections. If anything changes, drop an immediate reply here. :thumbsup:
